labels.name: Melanocyte
labels.function: Pigment-producing cell from which this cancer arises

labels.name: Stratum granulosum
labels.function: Upper reference point for measuring tumor thickness

labels.name: Stratum basale
labels.function: Deepest epidermal layer; normal home of pigment cells

labels.name: Ulceration
labels.function: Surface breakdown; worrisome feature used in T staging

labels.name: Pagetoid spread
labels.function: Atypical cells at all epidermal levels; favors malignancy

labels.name: Breslow thickness
labels.function: Single most important prognostic factor in invasive disease

labels.name: Papillary dermis
labels.function: Clark 2 if partly involved, Clark 3 if fully involved

labels.name: Reticular dermis
labels.function: Clark 4 when reached without entering the fat

labels.name: Subcutaneous tissue
labels.function: Clark 5, the deepest level of invasion

labels.name: Lymphatic vessel
labels.function: Invaded more often as depth increases; route to nodes

labels.name: RAS
labels.function: Membrane GTPase that starts this kinase cascade

labels.name: BRAF
labels.function: Mutated in about half of cases, most often V600E

labels.name: MEK
labels.function: Kinase blocked by trametinib and binimetinib

labels.name: ERK
labels.function: Final kinase driving tumor cell survival

labels.name: PD-1
labels.function: T-cell receptor blocked by nivolumab and pembrolizumab

labels.name: CTLA-4
labels.function: Inhibitory T-cell receptor blocked by ipilimumab

labels.name: T cell
labels.function: Effector cell unleashed against the tumor by checkpoint blockade
